title: Subarray Product Less Than K
summary: Given an array of integers and a product threshold, count the number of contiguous subarrays whose product is less than the threshold.
statement: Given an array of integers and a product threshold, count the number of contiguous subarrays whose product is less than the threshold.
constraints: All nums values are positive; 0 <= k <= 1,000,000.
Count contiguous subarrays whose product is strictly less than k.
hints: With positive values, shrinking the left edge can only decrease a window product.
Maintain the longest valid window ending at each right index.
Multiply the new value; divide from left while product>=k; add window length.
Every suffix of a valid positive-product window is also valid, so right-left+1 counts exactly the new subarrays.
editorial: Every suffix of a valid positive-product window is also valid, so right-left+1 counts exactly the new subarrays.

tests.explanation: The eight valid subarrays include all singles plus [10,5], [5,2], [2,6], and [5,2,6].
No positive product is less than zero.
